cards.front: Recall a key point about Subjunctive Mood and Complex Structures
cards.back: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for subjunctive mood and complex structures. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse spanish exam tips?
cards.back: The subjunctive is used after expressions of will, emotion, doubt and impersonal expressions. Form the present subjunctive by swapping the -ar/-er/-ir endings. Common triggers: quiero que, es necesario que, dudo que, ojalá. Higher marks require accurate subjunctive use.

cards.front: What does el examen oral mean?
cards.back: the speaking exam (e.g. El examen oral dura doce minutos)
the role-play (e.g. El rol-play requiere práctica)
the presentation (e.g. Mi presentación trata sobre mi ciudad)
